method: Manual source-unit review for nine exact accepted provider groups where legacy university country may be null. Accepted full official institution name uniquely identifies the existing group; no country or identity metadata changed.

supportingUnits.name: Logistics, Service & Operations Management (LSOM)
supportingUnits.evidence: Official Academic Groups page expands LSOM as Logistics, Service & Operations Management and describes logistics, manufacturing, supply chain, optimization and management science scope. Faculty page identifies area chair.

supportingUnits.name: Department of Management Science
supportingUnits.evidence: Official departmental faculty page names multiple Operations Management, Operational Research, Logistics and Supply Chain Management positions, and a department head, within Management School.

supportingUnits.name: Marketing & Supply Chain Management
supportingUnits.evidence: Official faculty page explicitly identifies Head of Department under Marketing & Supply Chain Management, followed by academic staff and doctoral candidates.

supportingUnits.name: Department of Finance, Supply Chain and Transportation
supportingUnits.evidence: Official departmental roster explicitly establishes combined full name, college parent and supply-chain faculty.

supportingUnits.name: Department of Operations Management and Information Systems
supportingUnits.evidence: Department explicitly named in tour/contact text; operations programs and supply-chain certificate establish scope.

supportingUnits.name: Operations Management
supportingUnits.evidence: Official business-school faculty navigation names Operations Management alongside other faculty subject areas and lists its faculty; it is not labeled a standalone department.

supportingUnits.name: Operations Management
supportingUnits.school: Faculty of Data and Decision Sciences
supportingUnits.evidence: Official wholefaculty research inventory explicitly lists OperationsManagement as researchfield, not standalone department.

supportingUnits.name: Operational Strategy
supportingUnits.evidence: Official school academicresearch inventory explicitly lists OperationalStrategy; retained as area, no separate department asserted.

supportingUnits.name: Department of Operations Research
supportingUnits.evidence: Current official Business School institutional profile explicitly identifies the Head of OR & OM Department and in its biography the Head of the Operations Research Department. This supplies actual department status independently of the earlier academic-area inventory; not inferred from a professor research topic.

validation: Each exact tuple and public official read evidence URL/date/unit passes pure reconcileSourceUnit. No merger/public edits/fresh reads.
limitations: These source assertions are unit identities only. Current title-scope eligibility of Operational Strategy, SCM or other research areas remains separately adjudicated.
Country null values did not justify dropping these accepted groups from the source-gate audit; preserved original university data and source group countries.
